label: c-refuter-1
tail:
No fatal findings. No nonfatal findings.

Key checks:

- Monad and comonad axioms use consistent whiskering, including all componentwise equations in [def-monad](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-monad.md:27) and [def-comonad](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-comonad.md:23).
- For the induced monad, naturality of \(\varepsilon\) gives
  \[
  \varepsilon_{FA}\circ FG(\varepsilon_{FA})
  =\varepsilon_{FA}\circ\varepsilon_{FGFA},
  \]
  and the two unit laws follow from the stated triangle identities. The Given supplies all required adjunction data.
- The opposite-adjunction argument produces \(FG\), counit \(\varepsilon\), and comultiplication \(F\eta G\) on the correct side.
- The size Remark agrees exactly with the library convention: a small \(\mathcal C\) gives a small—and hence locally small—\([\mathcal C,\mathcal C]\); a large source is only metatheoretic shorthand under this ZFC convention. See [the Remark](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/rem-a-monad-is-a-monoid-in-the-endofunctor-category-only-when-that-category-exists.md:23), [the functor-category definition](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/def-functor-category.md:27), and [the size proposition](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/prop-size-of-functor-categories.md:26).
- The algebra homomorphism equation, free algebra \((TA,\mu_A)\), and Eilenberg–Moore counit \(a:(TA,\mu_A)\to(A,a)\) are correctly typed.
- In [the Eilenberg–Moore theorem](/Users/ianx/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-the-eilenberg-moore-adjunction-induces-the-given-monad.md:26), \(U^TF^T=T\) on objects and morphisms, the unit is literally \(\eta\), and
  \[
  (U^T\epsilon F^T)_A=\epsilon_{(TA,\mu_A)}=\mu_A.
  \]
  Thus the induced monad is equal on the nose, not merely isomorphic. The cited constructions also match the relevant sections of [Riehl’s text](https://emilyriehl.github.io/files/context.pdf) and [Richter’s text](https://www.math.uni-hamburg.de/personen/richter/bookdraft.pdf).

Boundary checks:

- The empty category makes the monad/comonad equations and naturality families vacuous; the induced adjunction and Eilenberg–Moore constructions remain valid.
- A zero object requires no preservation assumption: the free algebra is \((T0,\mu_0)\), without any claim that \(T0=0\).
- The identity monad and identity adjunction satisfy every displayed formula and verify the degenerate case.
- No assigned claim has a numerical parameter, so \(n=0\) and \(n=1\) are genuinely inapplicable.
- No choice or nonempty-family selection occurs.
- The only equivalence assertion, comonads on \(\mathcal C\) versus monads on \(\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\), works in both directions using \((\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}})^{\mathrm{op}}=\mathcal C\).

Coverage: I read all ten assigned items fully, both page files fully, every direct dependency fully, and the three transitive size-convention dependencies needed for the Remark. I sampled nothing and encountered nothing I could not check.
